newsitem.title: USA: Continental cuts some Britain-U.S. fares.
newsitem.headline: Continental cuts some Britain-U.S. fares.

text.p: Continental Airlines said on Tuesday it cut round-trip fares for some flights from England to the United States this winter.

The company said in a statement that the fares went into effect on Tuesday and will run through March 15. Return tickets must be purchased seven days in advance and require a Saturday night stay with a maximum stay of one month. Other restrictions apply.

The round-trip fares from London and Manchester to New York, Washington, Boston and Baltimore start at $299 (179 stg). Flights to San Francisco and Los Angeles start at $484 (289 stg) and to Miami at $417 (249 stg). London-Orlando fares start at $417 (249 stg) and Manchester-to-Orlando flights start at $384 (229 stg).
A Continental spokeswoman in Houston said the new fares were in response to a similar fare cut by Britain's Virgin Atlantic Airways, part of the Virgin Group.
